title.narrative: Additional financial support supplement for the project to expand the cholera response throughout Yemen

description.narrative: Overall Project Objective: This project provides additional financial support to the project to expand the cholera response throughout Yemen, bringing the total amount allocated to combating the cholera epidemic in Yemen to $5 million. This comes as a result of the continued widespread cholera epidemic in Yemen, which has posed a significant challenge to the Yemeni Ministry of Health and public health programs. The project aims to reduce cholera-related mortality rates and support hospitals and health centers with medicines, intravenous solutions, and antibiotics to treat cases. The project also includes various activities related to investigation, environmental sanitation, water, and community education, in addition to supporting the organization's efforts in vaccination campaigns throughout Yemen.

Reducing mortality rates 2- Treating disease cases 3- Supporting the resilience of the health sector. 4- Supporting health facilities, including hospitals and medical centers, through the project. 4- Reducing transmission cases by increasing community awareness and health education.
